name: smartsolutions-admin-preview
description: Preview admin console for smartsolutionsai.us — reads live data, writes nothing.

scripts.check: node scripts/contrast.mjs && node scripts/check.mjs && npm run --silent check:numbers
scripts.check:numbers: node scripts/dump-model.mjs > /tmp/ss-model.json && curl -sf http://localhost:8787/api/books-overlay -o /tmp/ss-overlay.json && curl -sf http://localhost:8787/api/data/owners.json -o /tmp/ss-owners.json && python3 scripts/verify-numbers.py /tmp/ss-model.json /tmp/ss-overlay.json /tmp/ss-owners.json && node scripts/dump-buy.mjs > /tmp/ss-buy.json && curl -sf http://localhost:8787/api/data/manager.json -o /tmp/ss-manager.json && python3 scripts/verify-buy.py /tmp/ss-buy.json /tmp/ss-manager.json
